name: Shrewd
description: Sees the profit in a deal before others do.

name: Prudent
description: Reads a merchant's books, and his face, before lending.

name: Reckless
description: Trusts a handshake and a good dinner.

name: Well-connected
description: Dines with ministers and corresponds with courts.

name: Aloof
description: Cold with the bourse; respected, never liked.

name: Charismatic
description: Depositors trust a face they like.

name: Hale
description: Walks the Zeil every morning, whatever the weather.

name: Spendthrift
description: Never refuses a tailor, a tutor or a ball.

name: Pious
description: Never misses a sermon, and remembers the poor.

name: Gambler
description: Loves a long shot, and backs too many.
